title: Aura
tagline: AI-powered outfit assistant for the visually impaired
summary: An assistive app that helps blind users pick outfits matching the occasion, powered by a custom-built AI model and RFID tags.
problem:
Blind and visually-impaired individuals often struggle to dress appropriately for specific occasions because they cannot visually verify outfit combinations. Existing solutions rely on memorisation or sighted assistance, which limits independence.

Aura tackles this by combining RFID-tagged clothing items with an on-device AI model that recommends outfits based on the purpose the user states (e.g. work, casual, formal).
features: Custom-trained ML model for outfit matching by occasion
RFID scanner integration to identify garments instantly
Voice-first interaction tuned for screen reader users
Wardrobe registration flow with audio confirmations
learnings: Designing UX for non-visual primary users completely changes default assumptions.
Quantising a TensorFlow model for on-device inference on mid-range Android phones.
Bridging native RFID hardware events into a Flutter app via platform channels.

title: Visio
summary: A playful, audio-first learning app that helps blind children grasp object meanings and social interactions through gamified lessons.
problem: Inclusive education tools for blind children are scarce. Visio uses real-time object detection to turn a phone camera into a guided learning companion, narrating what the child encounters and reinforcing concepts through small games.
features: Mini-games that reinforce vocabulary and social cues
learnings: Optimising TFLite models for sustained real-time inference on phones.
Co-designing with educators to validate pedagogical effectiveness.

title: Tukerin
tagline: Battery-swap network for Indonesian EV riders
summary: Tukerin helps Indonesian EV users locate nearby battery-swap stations and trigger instant swaps directly from the app.
problem: EV adoption in Indonesia is bottlenecked by long charging times and uneven charger distribution. Battery swapping is faster but requires coordinating availability across stations. Tukerin gives riders a real-time map of nearby stations and lets them reserve a charged battery before arrival.
features: Live station availability on Google Maps

title: Tanivest
summary: Tanivest connects investors with smallholder farmers, unlocking capital and modern tooling to keep farmland productive.
problem: Indonesia loses thousands of hectares of farmland annually because smallholders lack capital and efficiency tools, pushing entrepreneurs toward more lucrative industries. Tanivest pools micro-investments to fund farm projects and shares yields back to investors.
features: Browseable list of investable farm projects
KYC + secure wallet on Firebase Auth/Firestore

title: Infarm
summary: An e-commerce platform that lets Indonesian farmers compare vendors and access fair prices on seeds, fertiliser, and equipment.
problem: Post-COVID supply disruptions left Indonesian farmers paying inflated prices for inputs with limited vendor choice. Infarm aggregates suppliers into a single marketplace where farmers can compare prices, read reviews, and order in bulk.
